text: ὁ Διναύσαρος καὶ ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ἡ Γλαὺξ παίζουσι τῇ σφαίρᾳ παρὰ τὴν οἰκίαν.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur stands in the center tossing the ball upward with a happy smile
Panda sits on the ground to the left, clapping his paws cheerfully
Koala stands to the right with her arms outstretched to catch the ball
Glaux perches on a low garden fence post with wings spread in joy
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is in the air above Dinosaur
